pages.text: The $(d)Potion of Mutation$() is used to craft $(l:geneticsresequenced:items/potion_of_cell_growth#gmo_cell)Genetically Modified Cells$(/l) that are set to $(9)mutation Genes$().$(br2)Mutation Genes are effectively just $(9)more powerful$() Genes, and generally $(c)require other Genes$().
